# Data Acquisition Report

## Report

The acquisition method that our group used was web scraping. We scraped the top 100 song data every 5 years from 1980-2020. We scraped from Wikipedia's Lists of Billboard Year-End Hot 100 Singles page for each of the years. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:Lists_of_Billboard_Year-End_Hot_100_singles) We used the tidyverse, httr2, and rvest R packages in order to do this. We used three different user agents in order to make these requests (one for each member of our group). We are allowed to scrape this data since we aren’t banned from it, and we are citing Wikipedia as the source of our data.

Every five years beginning with 1980: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:Lists_of_Billboard_Year-End_Hot_100_singles

## Acquisition Code

```{r}
#|warning: false
#|echo: false
#|label: 1980-1995, Emma

library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(rvest)

#1980s
url_1980<-"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_Year-End_Hot_100_singles_of_1980"

request(url_1980)%>%
  req_user_agent("Emma Smith, Data 2004 Class, Transylvania University")%>%
  req_perform(path="Data/Raw/music_1980.html")

#pulled 11/5/2026 at 11 AM

music_1980<-read_html("Data/Raw/music_1980.html")

table_1980<-music_1980%>%
  html_elements("table.wikitable")%>%
  html_table()
  
table_1980<-table_1980[[1]]

#1985

url_1985<-"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_Year-End_Hot_100_singles_of_1985"

request(url_1985)%>%
  req_user_agent("Emma Smith, Data 2004 Class, Transylvania University")%>%
  req_perform(path="Data/Raw/music_1985.html")

#pulled 11/6/26 at 11:26 PM

music_1985<-read_html("Data/Raw/music_1985.html")

table_1985<-music_1985%>%
  html_elements("table.wikitable")%>%
  html_table()

table_1985<-table_1985[[1]]

#1990

url_1990<-"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_Year-End_Hot_100_singles_of_1990"

request(url_1990)%>%
  req_user_agent("Emma Smith, Data 2004 Class, Transylvania University")%>%

#pulled 11/6/26 at 11:27 PM

table_1990<-table_1990[[1]]
```

```{r}
# Requested 11/03/2026 at 8:50pm.

two_thousand_ten_page <- read_html("Data/Raw/2010_songs.html")


two_thousand_ten_tables <- two_thousand_ten_page |> 
  html_elements("table.wikitable") |> 
  html_table()

length(two_thousand_ten_tables)

two_thousand_ten_tables[[1]]
two_thousand_ten_raw <- two_thousand_ten_tables[[1]]
View(two_thousand_ten_raw)
```
